Method of Attack: Trojan pretends to be a macOS cryptocurrency ticker app
Downloads and installs two backdoors (EggShell and EvilOSX) on infected macOS systems
Creates launch agents to start backdoors automatically on user login
Backdoors allow remote control of the infected computer
Discoverer: Malwarebyte's Director of Mac & Mobile Thomas Reed
Attack Vector: Installation of Trojan masquerading as CoinTicker app
Downloading backdoors from a Github repository
Indicators of Compromise: CoinTicker application download site with no contact info and only a download button
Customized EggShell and EvilOSX backdoors downloaded via python and shell scripts
Launch agents created for EggShell and EvilOSX backdoors
